sources.entry: wg-easy | The easiest way to run WireGuard VPN with a web-based admin UI

summary.one_liner: wg-easy is a Docker-based tool that runs a WireGuard VPN server together with a web-based admin UI for managing clients.
summary.what_it_does: The project bundles WireGuard and a web UI into one package for installing and managing a WireGuard VPN on a Linux host. From the UI you can list, create, edit, delete, enable, and disable clients, show a client's QR code, and download its configuration file. It shows which clients are connected, with Tx/Rx charts per connected client. The README also lists Prometheus metrics, IPv6 and CIDR support, 2FA, one-time links, client expiration, per-client firewall filtering (requires iptables), and OIDC login (for example Google, GitHub, Authelia, Authentik). The README points to a separate documentation site for installation guides covering Docker Compose, docker run, Podman, and reverse proxies such as Caddy and Traefik.
use_cases: run a personal WireGuard VPN server
manage WireGuard client configs through a web page
generate QR codes for mobile WireGuard clients
monitor connected VPN clients and their traffic
add two-factor or OIDC login to a VPN admin page
restrict per-client traffic with firewall rules
how_to_run: Install Docker (curl -sSL https://get.docker.com | sh, then log out and back in)
Run WireGuard Easy with Docker Compose following the Getting Started guide in the project documentation
Alternatively, use the docker run command or Podman, per the documentation
Optionally set up a reverse proxy to reach the Web UI securely
notable: All-in-one WireGuard server plus web admin UI
Prometheus metrics, IPv6, and OIDC/2FA support
Client QR codes and downloadable configs
caveats: Installation is documented on a separate site; the README itself gives only a quick start
Reverse proxy setup is optional but recommended for internet access to the Web UI
